{"reason": "v1 (accuracy=0.708, unknown=23) misses 14 costly rows: eight with market-mismatch=#t and four with forecast-bias=#t but bias 0.065–0.081 under the 0.1 cutoff, all truth demand-forecast-error, v1=unknown. Add a market-signal-mismatch branch and lower the bias threshold to 0.05, keeping supplier-delay first so accuracy and recovered amount should rise.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
